_note: The payload key holding tool output is deliberately NOT asserted. This fixture was originally hand-written from documentation with a `tool_result` key, and the adapter read the same invented name — so fixture and code agreed with each other while 842 real envelopes carried no result at all. The hook now reads no output key whatever it is called; results, exit status and usage come from the session transcript. See adapters/claude_code.rs::build_tool_call.
